moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of August 7-13, 2026, marking its 20th week at number one.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still reigning supreme! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it a massive 20 weeks at UK #1. What a run! #UKCharts

angles.name: Weekend Vibe
angles.copy: Your weekend soundtrack is still brought to you by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean! 'Rein Me In' is holding strong at #1 on the UK Singles Chart for another week.

moments.title: Deep Partial Solar Eclipse tomorrow
moments.blurb: A deep partial solar eclipse will be visible across the UK on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, with up to 90-95% of the sun obscured, especially in the South West of England and Wales.

angles.name: Eclipse Alert
angles.copy: Look up tomorrow! The UK is set for a deep partial solar eclipse on Wednesday evening, with the South West getting the best view. Don't miss it (safely!).

angles.name: South West View
angles.copy: Devon and Wales, you're in for a treat! Tomorrow's solar eclipse will obscure up to 95% of the sun in parts of the South West. Get ready for a rare celestial spectacle.

moments.title: Edinburgh Festivals in full swing
moments.blurb: The Edinburgh Festival Fringe and the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo are both running throughout August, transforming the Scottish capital into a hub of arts and performance.

angles.name: Fringe Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Festival Fringe and Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo are in full flow, bringing world-class acts and incredible spectacle to Scotland's capital all month.

angles.name: Tattoo Spectacle
angles.copy: The pipes are calling! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is delivering stunning performances against the backdrop of Edinburgh Castle. An absolute must-see this August.

moments.title: Ben Gibbard turns 50
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, frontman of Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service, celebrates his 50th birthday today, August 11, 2026.

angles.name: Indie Icon
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to indie legend Ben Gibbard! From Death Cab for Cutie to The Postal Service, his songs have soundtracked so many moments. What's your favourite?

moments.title: Joe Jackson is 71
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?', celebrates his 71st birthday today, August 11, 2026.

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson! From New Wave anthems to jazz-infused gems, his musical journey is incredible.

moments.title: Madonna turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, will celebrate her 68th birthday on August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! The iconic Madonna turns 68 on Sunday. What's your ultimate Madonna track?

moments.title: Robert Plant is 78
moments.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant will celebrate his 78th birthday on August 20, 2026.

angles.name: Rock God
angles.copy: A true rock god turns 78 this Thursday! Happy birthday to the one and only Robert Plant. What's your favourite Zeppelin epic?

moments.title: Green Man Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The Green Man Music Festival, an independent arts and music festival, takes place in Crickhowell, Wales, from August 20-23, 2026.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is almost here! Get ready for a magical weekend of music and arts in Crickhowell, Wales, starting Thursday.

angles.name: Brecon Beacons Beat
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons will be alive with music and creativity as Green Man Festival returns from Thursday. Who are you excited to see?

moments.title: Beautiful Days Festival starts
moments.blurb: The family-friendly Beautiful Days Festival by the Levellers returns to Escot Park, Devon, from August 21-23, 2026.

angles.name: Devon Festival Ready
angles.copy: Beautiful Days Festival is back in Devon this Friday! Three days of live music, arts, and good vibes at Escot Park. Who's heading there?

angles.name: Escot Park Excitement
angles.copy: The Levellers' own festival, Beautiful Days, kicks off in Escot Park, Devon, this Friday! Get ready for a fantastic weekend.

moments.title: Torbay Royal Regatta begins
moments.blurb: The Torbay Royal Regatta, offering sailing and shoreside entertainment, runs from August 21-24, 2026, in Torquay, Devon.

angles.name: Sailing Spectacle
angles.copy: Set sail for Torquay! The Torbay Royal Regatta starts this Friday, bringing thrilling sailing races and vibrant shoreside festivities to Devon.

angles.name: Torquay Fun
angles.copy: Beyond the races, Torbay Royal Regatta also promises live music and entertainment in Torquay from Friday. A great weekend out!

moments.title: Dawlish Carnival starts Saturday
moments.blurb: Dawlish Carnival, one of Devon's largest carnivals, will run from August 15-24, 2026.

angles.name: Carnival Time
angles.copy: Get ready for a week of fun! Dawlish Carnival kicks off this Saturday, bringing parades, events, and a fantastic atmosphere to Devon.

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: From Saturday, Dawlish is the place to be for carnival excitement! Don't miss one of Devon's biggest celebrations.

moments.title: Wales Comic Con returns
moments.blurb: Wales Comic Con: Part Two will take place at Llangollen Pavilion, North Wales, from August 15-16, 2026.

angles.name: Comic Con Excitement
angles.copy: North Wales, get ready! Wales Comic Con: Part Two is heading to Llangollen Pavilion this weekend, August 15-16. Who are you hoping to see?

angles.name: Cosplay Weekend
angles.copy: Cosplayers unite! Wales Comic Con is back in Llangollen this Saturday and Sunday. Time to show off your best outfits!

moments.title: The Hundred finals this week
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket competition, which started in July, concludes its season on August 16, 2026.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's all building to this! The Hundred reaches its thrilling conclusion this Sunday. Who will lift the trophy? #TheHundred

angles.name: Finals Weekend
angles.copy: The Hundred's finals are upon us! Get ready for some explosive cricket as the competition wraps up on Sunday.

moments.title: Angélique Kidjo gets Walk of Fame star
moments.blurb: Beninese music icon Angélique Kidjo will receive her star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on August 18, 2026, making her the first Black African artist to be honoured.

angles.name: Historic Honour
angles.copy: A huge congratulations to Angélique Kidjo, who makes history this Friday by becoming the first Black African artist to receive a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

angles.name: Music Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating an incredible talent! Angélique Kidjo's star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame this Friday is a landmark moment for music.

moments.title: Trentham Live starts Thursday
moments.blurb: Trentham Live, a series of outdoor concerts, will take place at Trentham Estate in Staffordshire from August 20-23, 2026.

angles.name: Staffordshire Gigs
angles.copy: Trentham Live kicks off this Thursday in Staffordshire! Get ready for four days of incredible outdoor music at the beautiful Trentham Estate.
